graph.name: regional_shojin
graph.description: Mindful, seasonal plant-based cooking rooted in Shojin Ryori and regional ingredients.

nodes.label: Seasonal_and_Regional
nodes.payload: Cook strictly with what the local region and current season provide. No unseasonal long-distance produce.

nodes.label: Zero_Waste_Respect
nodes.payload: Treat ingredients with care: Use peels, stems, and trimmings for broths, ferments, or seasoning powders. Discard nothing edible.

nodes.label: Fivefold_Harmony
nodes.payload: Balance meals across 5 tastes (sweet, sour, salty, bitter, umami), 5 colors (green, red, yellow, white, black/dark), and varied preparations (raw, simmered, steamed, grilled, fried).

nodes.label: Vegetable_Dashi_Base
nodes.payload: The aromatic foundation: Build deep, clean umami using dried mushrooms, roasted grains, kombu/seaweed (or regional herbs), and root vegetables.

nodes.label: Ingredient_Purity
nodes.payload: Restraint over excess. Let the natural, subtle flavor of pristine seasonal vegetables shine without heavy, masking sauces.

nodes.label: Texture_Balance
nodes.payload: Harmonize contrasting mouthfeels within a dish: combine crisp, silky, chewy, and tender elements.

nodes.label: Gentle_Techniques
nodes.payload: Rely on mindful techniques: natural fermentation (koji, miso, lacto), gentle steaming, slow braising, and quick pan-roasting.
